subject: Fix unexpected behavior when turning appendonly on and off within a transaction (#826)
reason: The fix only guards stopAppendOnly() against operating on an already-closed descriptor (aof_fd == -1) and adds log lines. That path is reached when AOF is enabled-but-merely-scheduled (inside EXEC, or with another background child active) and then disabled in the same transaction, leaving aof_fd == -1. On the parent this does flushAppendOnlyFile(1) (a provable no-op: empty buffer and incr offsets both 0, so it early-returns for every fsync policy and the always-exit path is unreachable), then valkey_fsync(-1) and close(-1), which return EBADF harmlessly and only emit a log warning.
